turns.text: The kids are at school, so it is quiet today.
We painted the shed last spring.

findings.instruction: Move the stacked logs more than 30 feet from the house, or cover them fully with sheet metal.
findings.reason: The first frame shows a stack of logs piled against the house wall.

findings.instruction: Replace the part of the wooden fence within 5 feet of the house with metal, brick or another material that will not burn.
findings.reason: The third frame shows a wooden fence joining the house wall.

findings.instruction: Cut and haul away the dry brush within 30 feet of the house, or bag it for yard waste pickup.
findings.reason: The second frame shows dead branches piled on the ground by the house.
